newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aides dismiss Libya spy case as propaganda.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aides dismiss Libya spy case as propaganda.

text.p: U.S. officials dismissed as a propaganda ploy on Thursday Libya's sentencing of six senior officers and two civilians to death on charges of spying with CIA-supplied equipment.

"This is not a new case and the proceedings have a show trial flavor," said one official authorised to speak about the matter. "They look like a propaganda ploy for internal consumption." The CIA declined comment.
Libyan state-run television said the eight were convicted of passing defence secrets to foreign governments and belonging to "a banned organisation linked to agents of foreign governments."

The report, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), did not name the governments but said the convicted men used equipment supplied by the Central Intelligence Agency and implied they were spying for the United States.
